problem_statement: Content-locked PP-VI-ReID motivation figure. Previous outputs looked stylistically plausible but had wrong scientific content.
existing_weakness: Coarse anonymization hides appearance but breaks useful ReID cues and creates Mixed Gap. Anonymous image is not a secure representation. Key protection can entangle identity and security features and collapse ReID discriminability.
method_summary: Use attached image as style reference. Portrait 3:4 motivation figure, not flowchart. Three stacked diagnostic panels with dashed separators, diagonal hatch, hand-drawn borders, Times-like labels, red crosses, green checks. (a) Blue panel: 'Precise & Consistent Anonymization'. RGB and IR images -> coarse anonymization. Green: 'Sensitive info hidden'. Red: 'Broken contours', 'Broken fine-grained cues', 'Shared structure damaged'. Red bidirectional 'Mixed Gap' between RGB anonymous features and IR anonymous features; label cause 'inconsistent RGB/IR impact'. Motivation callout: 'Suppress sensitive identity, preserve shared structure'. (b) Gold panel: 'Anonymous Image != Secure Representation'. Anonymous image alone is static/unsafe. Red branch: 'Unauthorized use', 'Identity leakage risk', red cross. Key-controlled lock/shield gate. Valid key branch: 'Authorized recovery' -> 'Retrieval representation', green check. Small labels: 'Controllable', 'Authorized', 'Verifiable'. No Mixed Gap in (b). (c) Green panel: 'Disentangle Utility and Security'. Key-protected features -> tangled cloud 'Identity cues + key/security cues'. Red: 'Feature entanglement', 'Discriminability collapse'. Split into 'Utility identity feature' -> 'Stable VI-ReID retrieval' green check, and 'Security key feature' -> 'Secure authorization' shield/check. No face recognition, no generic ML pipeline, no NLP/text/document.

figure.title: Motivation
figure.objective: Strict content. Three stacked panels: (a) anonymization hides sensitive info but breaks contours/fine-grained cues/shared structure and creates Mixed Gap from inconsistent RGB/IR impact; (b) anonymous image is not secure, key gate enables authorized recovery and verifiable retrieval representation; (c) key-protected features entangle identity and security cues, disentangle to stable VI-ReID retrieval and secure authorization. Style like attached PPA motivation. No global title.
